Every source byte eligible for the canonical P6 binding selects the fast recomputing verifier. The bounded broad prefixes are intentional: a future source-map addition inside the same runtime surfaces must fail closed until evidence is refreshed, while the expensive live matrix remains opt-in.

The canonical P6 producer and stored source-bound evidence select the direct recomputing verifier plus every component, durability, resource and private-artifact route regression. The default gate verifies stored observations; only the explicit update command runs the long real matrix.

The P7 source-bound producer is the only current Result Studio qualification owner. Default tests verify its independently resolvable fact-bundle contract and packaged CDP adapter; the explicit update gate alone builds and drives the real arm64 package with two configured Provider classes.
